# Agarwal Group

> Trusted real estate developer in Mumbai, Vasai, and Virar (MMR) since 1978, delivering RERA-registered residential and commercial developments.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/): Overview of Agarwal Group, ongoing residential projects, legacy since 1978, and enquiry options.
- [Ongoing Residential Projects](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/projects): Explore current RERA-registered residential developments in Vasai and Virar.
- [Completed Projects](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/completed-projects): Portfolio of 40+ delivered residential and commercial landmarks across Mumbai and Vasai–Virar.
- [About Us](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/about-us): Company heritage, vision, mission, and leadership since 1978.
- [FAQs](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/faqs): Frequently asked questions about homebuying, RERA registration, and site visits.
- [Contact Us](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/contact): Request a callback or book a guided site visit.
- [Channel Partners](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/channel-partner): Partner registration, benefits, and portfolio details.
- [Careers](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/careers): Open positions across sales, marketing, engineering, and customer relations.
- [Blogs](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/blogs): Real estate guides, homebuying tips, and MMR market insights.

## Featured Projects

- [Agarwal Infinity](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/projects/infinity): Spacious 2, 3 & 4 BHK homes in Virar West (MahaRERA: PR1240002502497).
- [Agarwal Sky Heights](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/projects/sky-heights): 29-storey residential tower offering 1, 2 & 3 BHK homes in Vasai East (MahaRERA: P99000054026).
- [Agarwal Skyrise](https://www.agarwalgroup.in/projects/skyrise): High-rise 1, 2 & 3 BHK residences in Virar West (MahaRERA: P99000053167).
